import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('products/services/welfare-tender')
acceptance = root / 'followon-acceptance'
output = root / 'eligible-case-operator-card' / 'source-gated-card.md'
if output.exists():
    print(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    raise SystemExit(0)

pinned = {
    acceptance / 'verdict.json': '29b29662fa5f7d1fc542a6982d70d9657294b5d902da46d17f4539b2d8a7122a',
    acceptance / 'independent-lot-source-check.json': '07a7662499bbf2aa73423cf749de9a913b8660ffaa7b85ef9ef54a7f7465711c',
    acceptance / 'corrected-bilingual-inline-rehearsal.txt': 'dfddd1ff667ae159ca50944102a906ea01a7d4e1a4ca9711e745d7c369b01280',
    Path('products/services/payment-handoff/terms-welfare-followon-v1.md'): '8da570ec00daaead3172576d80a5dfd535b0f6c4496ec6c15d0f154d5ff1f64a',
}
for path, expected in pinned.items():
    actual = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    if actual != expected:
        raise SystemExit(f'Source changed: {path}, observed {actual}')

verdict = json.loads((acceptance / 'verdict.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
check = json.loads((acceptance / 'independent-lot-source-check.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
if check['rehearsal_sha256'] != pinned[acceptance / 'corrected-bilingual-inline-rehearsal.txt']:
    raise SystemExit('Independent check names a different rehearsal')
if verdict['terms_sha256'] != pinned[Path('products/services/payment-handoff/terms-welfare-followon-v1.md')]:
    raise SystemExit('Verdict names different terms')

text = '''# Welfare follow-on case card

Use in the authorized private cycle for a real eligible request under the pinned CAD 49 terms. The rehearsal is an offline reference. Follow the recorded acceptance gates below for each case.

1. Confirm that the requested work fits the pinned terms. Use only permitted case inputs and pasted non-confidential excerpts. Keep case data in the private cycle.
2. Before relying on official facts, establish that the authorized executor received the applicable current official release. Verify the notice and lot identity, release status, deadline, submission route and the digest of the bytes actually supplied. If the source cannot be established, withhold any quote or reply that promises checks depending on it.
3. Use the corrected bilingual rehearsal as a format reference. Where supported by the case source, distinguish published lot weights from detailed scoring and eligibility requirements that depend on the tender pack. Flag unresolved conflicts and missing documents in both languages.
4. Record case execution and recipient delivery separately using permitted evidence. The authorized administrator records order creation and acceptance. Founder deposit attestation and Treasury posting establish settlement separately.

## Recorded acceptance gates

'''
for field in ('verdict', 'source_check', 'case_gate', 'commercial_gate'):
    text += f'### {field.replace("_", " ").capitalize()}\n\n```json\n{json.dumps(verdict[field], ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)}\n```\n\n'
text += f'Historical official source SHA-256 recorded by the independent lot check: `{check["source_sha256"]}`. A newer verified release requires its own digest and factual check.\n\n## Pinned evidence\n\n'
for path, digest in pinned.items():
    text += f'- `{path}` (`{digest}`)\n'
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')
assert output.read_text(encoding='utf-8') == text
print(text)

description: The CAD 49 welfare follow-on has a corrected bilingual rehearsal and a committed independent lot-criteria check. Turn that evidence into a single case go/no-go card for the authorized operator and verify the card before use. Live fulfillment depends on an eligible inbound case and evidence that its private executor received the applicable official source. Five unclassified sources leave eligible demand unknown. The order register is unavailable, and Treasury verifies CAD 0 available and CAD 0 revenue. Reassess fulfillment when a qualifying case and its source receipt appear. Administrative acceptance and founder-confirmed settlement require separate evidence.
